text:
morgan: quick sync: RFC pushed central decision service for canary/A-B. concern: routers depending on sync calls -> availability + latency. alternatives?

lee: prefer hybrid: policy authoritative but routers keep cached plans + subscribe for invalidations. lowers per-request RTT.

riley: subscription options: long-poll, SSE, websocket, or broadcast via control-plane message bus. prefer lightweight push (SSE/ws) for scale per region.

anya: if we push invalidations, need backpressure & reconnect handling. routers must fall back to cached plan or configured safe-mode.

devops-bot: alert: policy-service deploy at 13:04 UTC - potential impact window 5m :warning:
morgan: propose plan schema includes: plan_id, tenant_id, actions[{variant, weight, warmup, drain, start_ts}], ttl_ms, fail_mode (stable|degraded|isolate), signature. routers validate signature to avoid stale/rogue plans.

lee: +1 on signature. also include sequence number so routers can detect missed updates and request full snapshot.
riley: cache-coherence: two-phase: push delta + sequence. routers apply deltas atomically and expose plan_version metric. if gap detected -> full sync RPC.

anya: enforcement semantics sketch: if plan exists and not expired -> enforce weights. if policy unreachable & plan expired -> follow fail_mode. if plan missing -> enforce tenant-default (stable).
morgan: eviction and memory bounds: routers should cap cached plans by LRU and expose eviction_count. for large multi-tenant routers, prefer on-demand fetch + push subscriptions for hot tenants.

lee: weight transitions: add smoothing window and step_size to prevent flips. example: step_size=5% every 30s until reach target. also allow immediate override for emergency kills.
riley: session-affinity: each plan action can include affinity_hint and drain=true flag so existing sessions continue until TTL or drained. critical to avoid user disruption with KV caches.

anya: local heuristics: routers can run a small safety policy: if error_rate > threshold or p95 latency spike on canary, shift to safe route and emit decision_override event. these should be visible in telemetry and correlate with plan_id.
devops-bot: incident: router-region-eu lost contact with policy for 00:04:23 - cached plans used :information_source:
morgan: telemetry keys required: plan_id, plan_version, decision_age_ms, last_policy_contact_ts, plan_source(cached|push|rpc), decision_overrides, plan_expiry_count, eviction_count. dashboards + alerts on policy_unreachable_count and stale_decision_rate.

lee: playbook: if policy unreachable > 2x TTL -> page oncall. if decision_overrides > X in 1m across >N routers -> auto-rollback of latest rollout. include plan_id in page.
riley: API sketch for pushes and sync: POST /v1/plans (create/update) -> push broker fanout. GET /v1/plans?tenant= -> full snapshot. /ws/subscribe?region=... -> delta stream with sequence numbers.

anya: add enterprise controls: per-tenant min_ttl and forced_fail_mode for compliance tenants. also audit log for all plan mutations.
morgan: ok i'll write follow-up RFC with: push vs poll tradeoffs, schema, sequencing, safety heuristics, operator playbook, and perf budget numbers (rss/memory per cached plan). will include example metrics and emergency kill flows. any other asks?

lee: add estimated memory footprint for 10k tenants cached on edge routers and recommended eviction thresholds.
riley: include test plan: chaos test for policy unavailability, overlay test for quick weight-stepping, and affinity-preserving drain test.

anya: also add simulated smoothing algorithm and knobs for ops.
morgan: thanks all. i'll post draft in #architecture-rfcs and tag reviewers. :white_check_mark:
